title: UNESCO-TWAS/FAPESP Call for Proposals for Postdoctoral Fellowships for Researchers from Developing Countries
level: Postdoctoral researchers (doctorate within the last seven years)
about: UNESCO-TWAS and FAPESP call for postdoctoral fellowships for researchers from TWAS-defined developing countries (Brazil excepted), hosted at institutions in São Paulo state. After a candidate-supervisor match, the supervisor submits the full proposal to FAPESP through SAGe.
requirements: Native and permanent resident of a country classified by TWAS as developing, with the exception of Brazil
Doctorate in an area of natural, applied or social sciences, applying within seven years of obtaining it
Not already in Brazil and not holding a temporary or permanent residence visa in Brazil or in any developed country
A matched supervisor in the state of São Paulo who submits the full proposal to FAPESP through SAGe

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "the supervisor submits the full proposal to FAPESP" (a postdoctoral research proposal) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Doctorate in an area of natural, applied or social sciences" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
